title: The projection worker reaches the profile service over the real TLS edge
defect: The worker built a plaintext, anonymous channel (Channel::from_shared(..).connect_lazy()) to an HTTPS listener whose caller registry admits only the Concert workload. Every round failed before reaching the source, and because a round failure is retried by design nothing surfaced: discovery_profiles stayed empty and last_failure stayed null.
fix: GrpcDiscoverySource::connect uses platform::grpc_tls::lazy_channel_for_edge_with_optional_tls addressed to the Profile workload, plus ServiceIdentityClientInterceptor presenting the Concert workload credential - the same shape as intro_posts::claims_adapter::ProfileClaimsAdapter::connect.
DiscoveryProjectionSettings now carries the credential (CONCERT_SERVICE_CREDENTIAL) and refuses to start live without it, so an anonymous worker cannot be configured.
main.rs captures the TLS material before runtime is moved into the gRPC closure and passes it to connect.

commands.note: the gate as a whole is FAIL because the intro surfaces (steps 2-4) are not composed; step6_discovery_projection is PASS. See row_evidence.

row_evidence.database: mcr_concert (the concert service's database, on the gate's private TLS cluster)
row_evidence.favorites_query: SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_favorite_items WHERE profile_id='<target>'
row_evidence.account_query: SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_profiles WHERE account_id IS NULL OR account_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
row_evidence.note: The assertion is a row count, not a process fact. The worker started successfully in the defective build too; that is why a 'did it start' check passed while the projection stayed empty.

cases.note: A row appears in discovery_profiles on the real TLS stack: 0 -> 3, within the bounded wait.
A favorites change propagates: discovery_favorite_items gains 1 row for the target profile.
Every projected profile carries a non-nil account_id, which is the condition intro_posts::facts::blocks needs to stop denying.

A transport failure lands in discovery_projection_state.last_failure. discovery_worker.rs::a_transport_failure_lands_in_last_failure points a real GrpcDiscoverySource at a closed port (connect_lazy succeeds, calls fail - the same trap) and requires last_failure = 'profile_source'.
The worker recovers after a transport failure. ::the_worker_recovers_after_a_transport_failure requires the marker to clear and the projection to populate.
No cross-database join: the worker reads through gRPC; the projection is written locally.
A source failure never clears the projection; the worker does not exit on a round failure; shutdown is clean. All covered by the unchanged worker tests.

limitations: The gate as a whole is FAIL: steps 2-4 (intro surfaces) still fail and step 5 is BLOCKED. Those are WP-05 composition gaps, not this defect. Step 6 proves the projection now reaches the source and mirrors real rows with account ids, which is the precondition those steps were missing.
The favorites propagation check seeds a catalog item first; before this change the gate's seed_catalog only inspected the table and never inserted, so the check was skipped rather than failing.
